**Telegram Notification**
- Sent message for this occurrence to Ethereum Protocol Updates channel

In case I can't make tonight's call, I wanted to express my support for integrating Portal history network into Besu.
Work on this integration has already begun by the devs working on Samba, the standalone Java portal client.

There are mixed opinions in the Besu team in light of the recent changes so our implementation plans are not finalized.

Portal without the rest of the subnetworks is admittedly a less attractive prospect so I'd like to understand the advantages of the history-only version compared to a solution over devp2p.
